annotatedSteps.studentWork: Frog is at the second trophic level.
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: × Frog is at the third trophic level (grass is 1st, grasshopper is 2nd).
annotatedSteps.correctedWorking: Frog is at the third trophic level.

annotatedSteps.studentWork:

annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: ✓ Correct prediction that grasshoppers will increase.

annotatedSteps.description: Providing a scientific reason for the population change
annotatedSteps.teacherAnnotation: × Reason omitted (absence of predators/frogs to prey on them).

teacherNote: The 10% energy law was applied accurately, and the population trend in part (iii) was correct. Remember that producers occupy the first trophic level, making the frog the third trophic level, and always ensure you write the required explanation/reason in two-part questions.
